evidence.section: 3.4 Mechanical properties of the NbTaTiV RHEA
evidence.quote: The NbTaTiV RHEA, which was sintered at 1700 oC, exhibits the highest microhardness of 510.9 HV , much higher than 298 HV for the as-casted alloy [11].

evidence.section: 3.4 Mechanical properties of the NbTaTiV RHEA
evidence.quote: The yield strength of NbTaTiV RHEA sintered at 1500 oC, 1600 oC and 1700 oC are 1108 MPa, 1308 MPa, and 1373 MPa, respectively, while their maximum compressive fracture strength are 1821 MPa, 2073 MPa, and 2189 MPa, respectively.

evidence.section: 3.4 Mechanical properties of the NbTaTiV RHEA
evidence.quote: As the compression temperature increased to 1000 oC, the NbTaTiV RHEA sintered at 1700 oC still retains high yield strength of 437 MPa, which is much higher than that of typical ductile RHEAs, such as HfNbTaTiZr [26], NbTiVZr[27], HfMo0.5NbSi0.3TiV0.5 [28], etc.
The NbTaTiV RHEA sintered at 1700 oC exhibits a hardness of 510 HV, yield strength of 1.37 Gpa, and compressive fracture strength of 2.19 Gpa with a fracture strain of 23% at room temperature.
